card.title: Prophecy Under Revision
card.instruction: Project absolute certainty about what happens next while quietly revising the prophecy whenever reality disagrees.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Set our best plates out. A visitor wearing gold will bring us a fortune tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the plumber with brass fittings. I'll get his payment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Working gold. Leave the money; he'll be bringing ours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His bill's enormous. We owe him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fortune changing hands. Precisely as foretold. Make the cheque payable to him; the prophecy concerns the amount, not the direction.
